name: CheckInvoiceDocuments
description: 2c engine for a 'missing delivery notes / invoices' request: per invoice, how many delivery notes are scanned out of the total (DeliveryNotes by invoiceNumber, total = max(Invoices.deliveryNotesExpected, notes found)). Invoices that do not belong to the email's customer are refused (never packaged for another customer). All scanned → a Disputes case (disputeType תעודת משלוח חסרה, status מוכנה לשליחה ללקוח) and a customer package draft in Approvals (kind מענה ללקוח, status ממתין, attachments = invoice document + every scan; only to a verified sender). Something missing → the case with status ממתינה לסריקה, missingNoteNumbers, productLine, the logistics owner from ProductLineContacts, nextReminderAt = now + AgentSettings.logisticsReminderHours, and an internal logistics request draft (CreateDocumentRequest, kind פנייה ללוגיסטיקה, never sent). Idempotent per invoice: an open case for the same invoice is updated, not duplicated. Writes nothing to Priority.

invoiceNumbers.description: Invoice numbers the customer asked about

customerCode.description: Customer the request belongs to; defaults to the email's customer

inboundEmailId.description: InboundEmails row id of the request (links the case and the package to the email)

requestedBy.description: Who ran it (מאיה or a person's name)

dryRun.description: When true, only report the counts and what would be written; nothing changes

invoices.description: Per invoice: invoiceNumber, customerCode, customerName, expected, scanned, missingNoteNumbers, productLine, outcome, disputeId, approvalId

cancelledDraftIds.description: Pending פנייה ללוגיסטיקה drafts cancelled (נדחה, בוטלה – כל התעודות נסרקו) because the case is fully scanned
